# Elena Kuchimpos - Auto-Blog

## About

This is the personal website of Elena Kuchimpos, a neuropsych educator and director of IFOPAC (Instituto de Formación y Orientación Profesional en Altas Capacidades).

## Key Topics

- Neuropsychology and education
- High abilities (giftedness)
- Educational inclusion
- Teacher training
- Evidence-based education

## Site Structure

- Homepage: Professional profile, credentials, latest blog posts, media appearances
- Blog: Articles about education, neuroeducation, and inclusion
- Media: Interviews, press coverage, videos, and podcasts
- Contact: Professional contact information

## Content Language
